facts.fact: The GENIE school-ICT programme was adopted in 2006 by the telecommunications universal service management committee (CGSUT) and financed by the Telecommunications Universal Service Fund (FSUT), a fund paying for a named programme; the interview (2018) does not say what the fund collected or the law that set it up.
facts.system: Fonds du service universel des télécommunications (FSUT)

systems.system: Fonds du service universel des télécommunications (FSUT)

note: The fund-financed fact dates from 2006; the document is a 2018 interview and gives no figures.
